fusions.name: Headbutt Ring
fusions.desc: A butting rush of stings deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, knocks them back 3.5 tiles and makes them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stubborn Barb
fusions.desc: A horned sting that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite maximum health, makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stand Fast
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and hardens your armour by 6%. Stingers fight beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Footing Held
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.
